author: Gary Carter
text: Pipe under my sink cracked and started leaking. Their crew replaced it the same day. They secured all the connections. No more problems.

author: Autumn Miller
text: Our water meter was spinning even when everything was turned off. Sacramento Plumbing found a hidden leak in the crawl space and repaired it. The technician was very professional and explained how to monitor the meter. I feel much better knowing the leak is fixed.

author: Emma Jackson
text: Had Sacramento Plumbing do a repiping job and the technician did excellent work. He kept the space clean and explained each step. I’d recommend them to anyone wanting solid and trustworthy service.

author: Rafael Pereira
text: Great service and very professional. They helped with a water heater issue and walked me through what was happening in plain language. Quick turnaround and quality work.

author: Scarlett Bradford
text: The shower head connection began leaking slightly. I called this plumbing service to repair it. The technician resealed the connection and tested it. The leak stopped.
